Roleforge, every state

The approved Pipeline pass, applied to the rest of the app, with rev 3 (mobile) applied. 53 states. Left: live prod today at 390, dark, with sample data. Right: after, in HDS 0.29 type and the compact app density. It follows your light or dark setting. Nothing in the app is changed yet.

Sections
First runPipelineJob pageApply modeCompanies (Discover)Documents (was Templates)Account, notices and edges

Same rules everywhere

  1. HDS 0.29 type. Sora 700 headings, weights 700 and 500 only, no italic.
  2. Compact density. Steps 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32. Body 15, caption 13, UI 14, page title 24.
  3. One primary per page, inverse fill and bold. Disabled primaries are gone; empty input shows a field error instead.
  4. One banner at most. Sync is a Badge dot on the account Avatar. Sample data is one muted line with Clear.
  5. Panels with a header and rows; two columns on desktop where it helps. Dialogs and menus use the same 40px items.
  6. Rows: medium-weight titles, no underline, one 36px secondary action. One left edge per page.
  7. Rev 3. Lucide icons only (stroke 1.75; 16 in buttons, 20 in 40px icon buttons). Counts are neutral pills. Badges sit in one row above a title. Variables are chips everywhere. Segmented selections have a 1px strong border.

Decisions for you

  1. Track switcher in the page head. Companies has four control rows today (Manage track, track picker, location button, tool switch). The mock folds the picker into the title and location into a "Change" link. OK, or keep a visible picker?
  2. Dialogs on a phone. Mocked as bottom sheets (thumb reach) and centered on desktop. Or keep centered everywhere?
  3. Application kit. Empty fields fold into one "Fill in 11 more" form instead of 13 disabled Copy rows. OK to hide empty fields?
  4. A real 404. Unknown links go silently to Companies today. Add the not-found page?
  5. Today and Templates. Both are gone in prod (Pipeline top and Documents replaced them), so they are mocked as those. Confirm they stay retired.
